# Billed Right

## What Billed Right Does
Billed Right is a healthcare Revenue Cycle Management company and Enterprise Revenue Performance Partner founded in 2006 and headquartered in Longwood, Florida, in the Greater Orlando area. The company provides end-to-end RCM services to healthcare organizations across the United States, combining proven RCM expertise, scalable operations, data intelligence, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, AI, and expert human oversight.

## Who Billed Right Serves
Billed Right primarily serves enterprise-level healthcare organizations including large physician groups, multi-location and multi-specialty organizations, managed service organizations, private equity-backed healthcare platforms, and growing and transforming healthcare organizations. The company works with practices ranging from single providers to large enterprise groups of 25 to 100+ providers, with a focus on organizations managing real operational and financial complexity.

Priority specialties: cardiology, pain management, internal medicine, and behavioral health. Additional specialties include psychiatry, rheumatology, allergy and immunology, nephrology, urgent care, gastroenterology, primary care, vascular surgery, and pulmonary medicine.

## Services
Insurance eligibility verification, charge posting, documentation review, claim submission, denial management, payment posting, patient AR collections, AR follow-up, medical coding, reporting and analytics, account management, prior authorizations, documentation management, credentialing, and contract renegotiation.

## EMR Platform Expertise
Billed Right has deep operational expertise in eClinicalWorks (20+ years, dedicated internal team), IMS, AthenaHealth, and Central Reach. The company works inside existing client EMR systems without requiring system changes, data migration, or software replacement.

## Revenue Intelligence
Billed Right combines AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and experienced human oversight in a revenue operations model designed to move healthcare organizations from reactive billing to predictive revenue performance. Human professionals manage judgment, exceptions, compliance oversight, and quality assurance.

## Locations
Headquarters: 256 Rangeline Road, Longwood, Florida 32750 (Greater Orlando area)
US offices: Miami, Florida and North Canton, Ohio
India operations: Chennai and Trichy, Tamil Nadu

## Team
400+ team members across US and India operations.
